review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Opinions are divided whether school should reward the students who achieve the best academic performance or those who show their constant improvements. Personally, I reckon that school authorities should reward both of them.

Admittedly, it is obvious that the rewards are belonged to the students who have excellent academic gains. Initially, they are the one who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, accordingly, they deserve their praises and privileges. This, in fact, may encourages these students to try harder to win their rewards, propelling towards their overall academic gains. Moreover, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspects of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. It means that students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, enabling them to achieve success and experiences in later stage of life.

However, I believe that students who perform improvement should be praised. This primarily because only a few smart students can come first and received the rewards, which causes others to think that their effort is futile since they can not surpass those outstanding individuals and may make them lose their incentive to study. Furthermore, this can even emphasizing improvements, not only encourage all students to be diligent in their studies but also help students to understand when they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. As a result, this boosts the constant desire to outdo themselves may even benefits themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both individuals who have the excellent achievements and those who try their best should be rewarded equally. As it would be unfair to deny the success of one in favour of the others.
review.overall: Em đã bàn cả hai nhóm và dùng được nhiều ý đúng của dàn ý, nhất là cạnh tranh và nguy cơ mất động lực. Em cần viết lại để mỗi câu có chủ ngữ–động từ đầy đủ, dùng đúng dạng từ và nêu rõ hai nhóm trong kết luận.

paragraphs: Opinions are divided over whether schools should reward students with the best academic performance or whether it is more important to reward students who show progress. I believe that school authorities should reward both groups.

Admittedly, students with excellent academic results deserve rewards. Since they have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage them and other students to study harder, thereby contributing to overall academic gains. Moreover, competition exists in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Becoming familiar with this reality can help students thrive in the face of fierce competition, and this may prepare them better for success and help them gain experience in a later stage of life.

However, students who show progress should also be rewarded. This is primarily because, if only a few high-achieving students can come first and receive rewards, other students may think that further effort is futile because they cannot surpass these outstanding individuals. As a result, they may lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, recognizing improvement can encourage all students to work diligently and to understand that they need to keep improving themselves, irrespective of their current performance. This boosts the desire to outdo themselves, which may even benefit students more than competing against others.

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that schools should reward both students who achieve excellent academic results and those who make progress. It would be unfair to deny the success of one group in favour of the other.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
